approved_cost_and_conditions.subject: M12205 - approved cost and reporting requirements
approved_cost_and_conditions.content: Hi Agent, please search all five document categories for M12205 and retrieve only the Board Order numbered 102674. Review that one PDF: what total project cost did the Board approve, and what ongoing reporting did it require? Prepare a one-file ZIP with the response. If that exact document is unavailable, say so rather than substituting another order.
